#   Title is the page name DOC-11 uses in prose.
#   tier is full, overview or exempt. mode is warn or enforce. Under warn the
#   gate only reports; setting a repo's mode to enforce is the reviewed edit
#   that turns the gate on for it. A repo absent from this list is not checked.
#   The caller's own mode setting does not change this: the mode here governs.
